learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to ideally design value streams and map them in the production layout.
They are able to communicate complex relationships to the workforce and top management to increase the probability of implementation.
Furthermore, students in the field of machine tools are enabled to design and construct them according to modern manufacturing aspects.

This particularly includes considering accuracy requirements for machine tools, their mechatronic aspects such as drives, measuring systems, kinematics, materials, control and regulation, and integration into existing manufacturing systems.
Through this comprehensive training, students are well prepared to increase both efficiency and innovation in production and successfully accompany the implementation of new technologies.

syllabus_topics: Structure, components and parts of machine tools
Materials and constructive design of the overall system
Static, dynamic and thermal behavior of machine tools
Integration into manufacturing and procurement of machine tools
Value Adding and 3M / Lean Logistics and Supply Chain Management
The synchronous production system according to Takeda
Logistical principles and material flow technology
Basic Change-Management elements and their operational application
assessment_rules: The overall grade is determined by two exams: a 60-minute written exam or a take-home exam, and a 45-minute written exam. The two components are weighted equally (1:1).
